emails.body:
Hi,

We're under contract on 3784 Dunmore St in Brookvale. Signed February 3, 2026 at $660,000, closing April 23, 2026.

The survey landed Tuesday and it's bad. The detached garage and about eight feet of the driveway are sitting on the neighbor's parcel. Seller is Oakhaven Staffing, and their agent's position is that it's been that way for years so it isn't their issue. Our lender has already flagged it and is asking what we intend to do about it.

We would rather not walk away from this house. We are also not closing on an encroachment.

The property is in Bexar County, Texas. Is this something you could look at this week? I have the survey and the contract ready to send over.

Delphine Winslow
(897) 985-6550

emails.subject: rear ended in august, adjuster wont stop calling
emails.body:
I was rear ended on August 31, 2025 at Pelham Rd and Bellamy in Westfield. I was stopped at a light. The other driver was Greta Winslow and she was cited at the scene.

Since then I've done 18 rounds of physical therapy and my neck and shoulder are still not right. I'm at about $62,000 in medical bills and I've lost work on top of that.

Here's why I'm writing though. Their adjuster has called me four times now. He wants a recorded statement and he keeps floating a number to make this go away. I have not signed anything and I have not given him a statement.

This happened in Maricopa County, Arizona. Can somebody tell me what to do before he calls again? He said he'd try me Monday.

Victor Duvall
(959) 864-7964

Sent from my phone

emails.subject: Legal review needed - encroachment discovered before closing
emails.body:
Good morning,

I am looking for counsel to advise on a survey issue ahead of a residential closing scheduled for April 3, 2026.

By way of background: we contracted to purchase 3641 Gable Way in Fairhaven from Summit Ridge Systems Ltd. on January 4, 2026. The purchase price is $1,525,000.

The as-built survey, which we received this week, shows the detached garage and approximately eight feet of the driveway encroaching onto the adjoining parcel. The listing agent has characterized this as a pre-existing condition falling outside the seller's obligations. Our lender has flagged the survey and I expect underwriting to condition on it.

The property is located in King County, Washington.

I would like to understand our options and the realistic timeline for each well before we reach the closing date. Please let me know your availability this week and your rates.

Delphine Moreau
(917) 248-7615

emails.subject: supplier walked away mid-contract - what are our options
emails.body:
Hello,

I handle operations for Quarry Lane Hospitality Group Corp. and I'm trying to work out whether we have something worth bringing.

We signed a supply agreement with Juniper Orthopedics PLLC on May 1, 2024. The first year was fine - deliveries on time, no complaints from us. Then around December 14, 2025 everything stopped. No notice, no explanation, no termination letter. Just nothing.

We are sitting on roughly $469,000 in purchase orders they accepted and never filled, and we've had to buy the same goods elsewhere at a real premium to keep our properties running. I have emailed their contact three times and copied their AP address twice. Complete silence.

The agreement has a venue clause pointing to Hennepin County, Minnesota, which is where we're headquartered anyway.

Is this the kind of matter your firm takes? I can send the executed agreement, the PO history, and the whole email thread today.

Ingrid Fairchild
Operations, Quarry Lane Hospitality Group Corp.
(541) 691-7688

emails.subject: Breach of supply agreement - seeking counsel
emails.body:
We need representation on a supply contract that has been abandoned.

Counterparty: Meridian Mfg. Corp.
Agreement date: October 6, 2024
Last delivery: on or about August 23, 2025
Exposure: approximately $561,000 in unfilled POs

Noor Ferreira
Operations, Lakeshore Diagnostics LLC
(789) 625-3682

emails.subject: car accident last month, need advice
emails.body:
Hello,

I don't really know how this works so I apologize if this is the wrong place to send it.

On February 4, 2026 I was stopped at the light at Sable Court and Bellamy in Fairhaven and a woman named Eleanor Holloway hit me from behind. The police came out and she was cited. My car is still drivable but my neck has been a problem ever since.

I've been to physical therapy 14 times now. It helps for a day or two and then it comes back. My bills are around $56,000 at this point, which I cannot pay, and I've had to cut my hours at work.

The part that's worrying me is her insurance company. The adjuster has called me four times. Last time he asked me to do a recorded statement and mentioned settling. I told him I would think about it. I have not signed anything.

This all happened in Multnomah County, Oregon. Should I be talking to him at all?

Lucia Nakamura
(986) 691-1446

emails.subject: 11 years and then this
emails.body:
Hi,

I gave Oakhaven Robotics PLLC 11 years. Never a single write-up in my file.

On December 1, 2025 I told HR that our shift supervisor was signing off on safety inspection logs for inspections nobody performed. Three weeks later, on December 22, 2025, I was told my position was eliminated. They filled it about six weeks after that.

I don't think that's a coincidence and I don't think anyone would.

My salary was $94,000. I'm in Bexar County, Texas. I still have the email I sent to HR.

Is this worth pursuing? I'd rather hear no from you than keep wondering.

Delphine Mbeki
(222) 506-7465

emails.subject: Divorce - hoping to speak with someone
emails.body:
Hi,

I think I need a lawyer and I've been putting off writing this for two weeks.

My spouse is Yuki Bellweather. We married July 6, 2014 and separated October 19, 2025. We have two kids, 6 and 16, and the 16 year old has figured out more than we thought.

It has been civil. I want to keep it civil. But they retained someone last Thursday and a friend told me that means I can't wait anymore.

The house is the main thing - about $256,000 of equity in it. There's also a retirement account in their name and I'm told some of that may be partly mine since it was funded while we were married. I don't know how any of that works.

We're in Cook County, Illinois. Could someone tell me what a consultation involves and what it costs?

Anika Sandoval

emails.subject: Fired after reporting falsified safety logs
emails.body:
Hi,

I want to be careful to lay this out in order, because the order is the whole point.

November 9, 2025: I reported to HR that our shift supervisor was falsifying safety inspection logs. I put it in writing. I still have the email.

Nothing happened. No investigation that I ever heard about, no follow-up, nothing.

January 21, 2026: Ironwood Aggregates PLLC told me my position was being eliminated. Six weeks later they posted and filled the same job.

I was there 10 years with no write-ups of any kind. My salary was $118,000. I'm in King County, Washington.

I understand there are deadlines on this kind of claim and I don't know what they are. I'd like someone to look at it soon.

Victor Kavanagh
(842) 391-9684

emails.subject: Looking for representation - divorce
emails.body:

We're in Maricopa County, Arizona.

What does your consultation process look like, and do you handle collaborative divorce or only litigation?

Curtis Amador

emails.subject: Someone is selling under our mark - need a C&D fast
emails.body:
Hello,

We have a knockoff problem and I'd like it dealt with quickly.

Fairmont Holdings LLC has sold under the mark "Talmadgeloom" continuously since June 21, 2019. We hold a registration. The mark is printed on every unit we ship.

On December 30, 2025 a customer forwarded me a listing from Quarry Lane Property Group Ltd. The name is one letter off from ours. Same product category, undercutting us on price. The customer thought it was our product, which tells you everything about whether there's confusion.

We sent a polite note through their website contact form. Nothing.

That product line is roughly $2,157,000 of annual revenue for us, so this is not a rounding error. We are based in Fulton County, Georgia.

What does a cease and desist look like in this situation, how fast can it go out, and what happens if they ignore it?

Saoirse Ashford
Fairmont Holdings LLC

Sent from my phone

My salary was $77,000. I'm in King County, Washington. I have the HR email and I have the job posting saved.

I've read there's a time limit on filing. Is there any chance you could look at this in the next couple of weeks?

Constance Rosetti

Hello,

I was hurt on the job on 11/27/2025 - a pallet stack came down on my shoulder because the racking was overloaded. I filed a workers comp claim and had surgery in January.

I'm in Denver County, Colorado.

emails.subject: Inquiry re: breach of supply agreement
emails.body:
Good afternoon,

I write on behalf of Talmadge Industries Corp. to inquire whether your firm would consider representing us in a contract dispute.

We executed a supply agreement with Marlowe Analytics Corp. on June 13, 2024. The counterparty performed substantially in accordance with the agreement for approximately sixteen months. Deliveries ceased on or about October 18, 2025 without notice, without invoking any termination provision, and without response to our subsequent correspondence.

Our present exposure is approximately $451,000 in accepted but unfilled purchase orders, exclusive of cover costs, which continue to accrue as we source replacement supply at above-contract pricing.

The agreement designates Allegheny County, Pennsylvania as venue. Our operations are located in the same jurisdiction.

I can provide the executed agreement, purchase order history, and correspondence upon request. Please advise as to your availability and whether you perceive any conflict.

Victor Thornton
Operations, Talmadge Industries Corp.
(655) 928-7775

emails.subject: consultation
emails.body:
Hello,

I'd like to schedule a consultation about a divorce.

Spouse is Eleanor Rosetti. Married April 17, 2014, separated September 23, 2025. Two children, 6 and 14.

House has about $218,000 in equity. There's a retirement account in their name that I believe was partly funded during the marriage, though I don't have statements for it.

They have a lawyer as of last week. We're in Denver County, Colorado.

I'd prefer to keep this straightforward if that's possible. What's your availability?

Noor Duvall

emails.subject: Copycat listing - what are our options
emails.body:
Hello,

Northwind Distribution LLC has sold under the mark "Stonegateloom" continuously since August 29, 2020. It's registered and it's printed on every unit we ship.

On December 8, 2025 one of our own customers forwarded me a listing from Redbridge Hospitality Group LLC. The name is one letter off from ours. Same product category. Priced below us. The customer's message was essentially "did you change your packaging?" - which I'd think says something about likelihood of confusion.

We sent a polite note through their website contact form and heard nothing back.

That line is roughly $556,000 of annual revenue for us. We're in Hennepin County, Minnesota.

I'd like to know what a cease and desist involves, how fast it can go out, and what our realistic options are if they ignore it.

Malik Winslow
Northwind Distribution LLC

Sent from my phone

emails.subject: invoice INV-63606 - what is this charge?
emails.body:
Hello,

I received invoice INV-63606 dated 7 January 2026 on my employment matter. There's a $6,000 line item on it that I don't recognize, and I'm fairly sure it wasn't in what we discussed when we set expectations.

I'm not trying to be difficult. I'm paying this out of pocket while I'm out of work, so I need to understand what I'm paying for before I send anything.

Could someone explain that entry?

Felicity Moreau

emails.subject: scheduling - any news?
emails.body:
Camille,

You said on our call you'd have a better idea about scheduling by the end of the month on mat-0126.

Have you heard anything? I have to give my employer notice to take a day off and they're not flexible about it, so even a rough window would help.

Yuki Holloway

emails.subject: Re: Redbridge Construction LLC -- Employment Matter (Talmadge Systems Inc.) - and something else
emails.body:
Hi Camille,

Two things. First, nothing new on mat-0016, we're still waiting on their production and I assume you'll tell me when that lands.

Second and more urgent: we terminated a warehouse manager on 19 January 2026 and yesterday we got a demand letter from a firm representing him alleging disability discrimination. Completely unrelated to the mat-0016 business. Do you handle that or does it go to someone else there? The letter gives us fourteen days.

Redbridge Construction LLC

emails.subject: mat-0018 - need something to tell leadership
emails.body:
Priyanka,

Following up on last week's call about the Harborview Staffing matter. You thought you'd know more on scheduling by month end.

I have to brief our leadership on Thursday either way, so even "no date yet" is useful - I'd just rather not be surprised in the room.

Aurelio Thornton
Meridian Biosciences Co.

emails.subject: Settlement letter for Thursday's board meeting
emails.body:
Hi Sylvia,

Our board meets Thursday and the Copperfield Aggregates transaction is on the agenda. Could you send the most recent settlement letter on mat-0001 so I can take them through the actual language rather than my summary of it?

Separately, AP has invoice INV-68528 dated Feb 2, 2026 sitting in the queue. They believe it's the deposition prep but want that confirmed before releasing payment.

Thanks,
Gerald Ibarra
Ironwood Aggregates Ltd.

emails.subject: Termination following a safety report - seeking representation
emails.body:
Hello,

Apologies for writing from my new employer's address - I no longer have access to my old one, which is part of the problem.

On November 19, 2025 I reported to HR at Presidio Orthopedics PLLC that a shift supervisor was falsifying safety inspection logs. I put it in writing and I kept a copy at home.

On December 16, 2025 I was told my position was being eliminated. They filled it roughly six weeks later.

I was there 4 years. No disciplinary history. My salary was $92,000. I'm in Middlesex County, Massachusetts.

I understand there are filing deadlines and I'd like to know where I stand before one passes. What would an initial review involve?

Emmett Delacroix
(228) 388-9675

emails.subject: Partnership opportunity + a question
emails.body:
Hello,

I run Ashgrove Orthopedics LLP, we build intake software for small law firms and I'd love to show you what we've built - I think it would save your staff several hours a week.

Separately, and honestly this is the more pressing thing: we received a cease and desist last Tuesday from a company claiming our product name infringes their mark. We've been using the name for three years. Our response is due in fourteen days and we don't have counsel.

Happy to talk about either. Or both.

Tobias Winslow
Founder

emails.subject: Retaliatory termination - would like a consultation
emails.body:
Hi,

A friend who practices in another state told me to write to you and to be specific, so here goes.

September 23, 2025: I reported to HR at Juniper Foods PLLC that our shift supervisor was falsifying safety inspection logs.

November 11, 2025: I was terminated. "Position eliminated." Six weeks later the position was posted and filled.

Eight years there. Not one write-up. My salary was $170,000, so this is not a small thing for my household.

I'm in Bexar County, Texas. I have the HR email, the job posting, and my last three performance reviews, all of which were good.

What's your process and what does it cost to get an opinion on whether this is worth bringing?

Roland Whitfield
(933) 693-4886

emails.subject: Advice needed before I speak to an adjuster again
emails.body:
Hello,

I'm writing from work so please excuse the address.

On December 15, 2025 I was stopped at the light at Larkspur Ave and Bellamy in Hollis Park and was rear-ended. The other driver, Terrence Lindqvist, was cited at the scene.

Since then: 9 physical therapy sessions, ongoing neck and shoulder pain, roughly $46,000 in medical bills, and time lost at work.

The reason I'm writing today rather than last month is that the other driver's adjuster has now called me four times. He is asking for a recorded statement and has twice raised settling quickly. I have signed nothing and given no statement.

The accident occurred in Bexar County, Texas.

I would like advice before I speak to him again. What would that involve?

Malik Holloway
(331) 880-4971

emails.subject: asking for a friend
emails.body:
Hi,

A friend of mine was in a bad accident about two months ago and is still in the hospital so she asked me to reach out. The other driver ran a red light and there were witnesses. Her insurance is being difficult about the medical bills.

I don't want to share her details without asking her first. Can you tell me whether this is something you'd take and roughly what it costs? Then I'll have her contact you directly.

Thanks,
Felicity

emails.subject: Trademark infringement - Ridgeline Diagnostics L.L.C.
emails.body:
Hello,

Laying this out plainly since I assume you need the facts more than the frustration.

1. Ironwood Diagnostics LLC has sold under the mark "Presidioloom" continuously since January 20, 2019. The mark is registered.

2. On December 28, 2025 a customer forwarded us a listing from Ridgeline Diagnostics L.L.C. The name differs from ours by one letter. Same product category. Lower price point.

3. We sent an informal note through their website contact form. No response, no acknowledgment.

4. The affected product line represents roughly $1,332,000 in annual revenue.

We are based in Wake County, North Carolina.

Questions: what does a cease and desist cost and how quickly can one issue? If they ignore it, what is the realistic next step and what does that cost? I would rather know the whole path now than discover it in stages.

Delphine Bellweather
Ironwood Diagnostics LLC

emails.subject: Is this worth suing over?
emails.body:
Hello,

I'll be honest that I don't know whether this is worth anyone's time, including yours.

Northwind Property Group LLP signed a supply agreement with Windermere Holdings Ltd. on January 21, 2024. They were fine for about eighteen months. Around July 10, 2025 the deliveries just stopped. No notice, no termination letter, no answer to any of the three emails I sent.

We're out roughly $498,000 in purchase orders they accepted and never filled, plus whatever we've overpaid sourcing the same material elsewhere since.

Venue under the agreement is Fulton County, Georgia, which is where we are.

What I'd really like to understand before committing to anything is what this costs to pursue and what the realistic recovery looks like. If the answer is that we'd spend most of it on fees, I'd rather hear that now.

Terrence Ortega
Operations, Northwind Property Group LLP
(635) 886-3191

emails.subject: Certified court reporters - same day rough drafts
emails.body:
Hello,

We provide certified court reporting and videography across 12 states with same-day rough drafts and realtime streaming.

New clients receive 24% off their first three depositions.

Marguerite Sinclair
Precision Reporting Group

emails.subject: First house, and the survey just came back wrong
emails.body:
Good morning,

My partner and I are buying our first house and something has come up that we don't know how to handle.

The property is 2064 Sable Court in Riverton. We're buying from Ramona Whitfield, we signed on January 28, 2026 at $559,000, and we're supposed to close April 22, 2026.

The survey came back this week. The detached garage and roughly eight feet of the driveway are on the neighbor's land, not ours. The seller's agent says it's been that way for years so it isn't the seller's problem. Our lender has already flagged it and we don't know what that means for the loan.

We have been saving for this for six years and we don't want to lose the house. We also understand we shouldn't buy land that isn't the land.

It's in Fulton County, Georgia. Could someone talk to us this week? We're both free evenings.

Emmett Castellanos
(599) 227-8389

emails.subject: someone is using our name
emails.body:
Copperfield Dental Associates Incorporated is selling under a name one letter off from our mark and I want it stopped.

Background: Lakeshore Textiles Inc. has used "Meridiankit" continuously since October 16, 2019, registered. On February 13, 2026 a customer sent me their listing. Same category, cheaper, near-identical name.

We contacted them through their website. Nothing.

That line is about $681,000 a year for us. We're in Denver County, Colorado.

How fast can a cease and desist go out and what does it cost?

Priya Amador
Lakeshore Textiles Inc.

Sent from my phone
